approach.method_basis: The reference this node measures is the lineage's current best algorithm: a graph genetic algorithm whose oracle calls are chosen by Gaussian-process Thompson sampling, with one stall reflex on top. Each round it breeds a fresh field of 160 new molecules from a 64-member elite, drawing breeding parents mostly from the top score quantiles and building each child either by joining connected fragments of two parents, sometimes with one further edit, or by a short chain of atom, bond and ring edits. It throws away duplicates, molecules it cannot canonicalize, and any child that would introduce a sulfur environment its scored parents do not already carry. A Gaussian process trained only on the molecules scored so far in that same run, on count-based Morgan fingerprints with a Tanimoto-type kernel, predicts the whole fresh field; ten correlated posterior samples then each buy their best still-available candidate, and those ten molecules are the batch that gets scored. The reflex is what an earlier child added: after three consecutive rounds with no new best score, only the forty candidates with the highest predicted mean stay eligible to be bought, until a round improves again. Two independent random streams drive a run - one makes every breeding decision, the other draws only the ten posterior sample rows - and the reflex itself consumes no randomness. On the recorded runs the reflex governed 88 of 435 rounds across 13 of the 15 runs, and two runs never stalled at all.
approach.novelty: This node adds no search behaviour whatsoever. It is the placebo the allocator has never had on this algorithm: before the selector draws the ten posterior sample rows it needs for a round, it draws one extra block of random numbers of exactly the same size and throws it away unread, in every round of every run. Every rule, probability, threshold, constant and gate stays as it is; the eligible set, the predicted mean, the correlation structure, the purchase rule, the breeding stream and the molecules it makes are untouched. The only difference from the reference is which pseudo-random words the unchanged selector consumes, so what comes out is the distance a complete fifteen-cell panel travels on pure luck inside the one stream through which the arms that actually matter depart. That is new on this host. The two placebos already drawn here both perturbed the breeding stream, whose luck is worth about 0.035 ungated and 0.024 gated, and the two allocator placebos the lineage owns were drawn on the previous algorithm, the one without the reflex, where the same construction moved a panel by only -0.002 and +0.008. Siblings cannot supply it either: each of them changed a rule - a mixture predictor, a session-calibrated spread, greedy allocation, a doubled field, a different release rule for the restriction - or removed a dormant branch and reproduced the Parent exactly. Among the law-free positions standing on this same Parent in this round, this one is the ungated single-block point: one discarded block per round in every round, against a sibling that discards two and a sibling that discards only inside the rounds the reflex governs.

hypothesis: Law-free allocator-stream path divergence on the stall-masked Anchor, in the ungated exposure class. No law, probability, threshold, rule, constant, gate or mechanism changes anywhere. Inside the inherited posterior allocation, after the pool posterior covariance has been factorized on the inherited jitter ladder and immediately before the inherited correlated Thompson draw consumes its own standard-normal array, draw exactly one additional array of precisely the inherited allocation shape - (announced batch size, pool size) = (10, 160) on this Parent's own path, float64, on the selector's own device - from the selector's own seeded torch generator, the single consumer of that stream, and discard it unread; then let the unchanged allocation proceed. This happens in every announced batch of every session, regardless of the inherited stall state, and nowhere else. Its only effect is that the allocator stream is advanced by exactly one array per announced batch, so the batch that the Anchor served with its n-th array is served here with its 2n-th, and every later allocation consumes the next unused block of the same i.i.d. stream. The posterior fit and its adaptive normalization, the fitted covariance and both Cholesky factorizations with their jitter ladder, the predictive mean and its (-posterior mean, pool index) ordering, the sampled-maxima purchase rule with its per-pick mask update, the stall-conditioned eligibility mask with K=3 and M=40 and its restoration on the first improving batch, the 160-member fresh pool and its target, the Evolution's own breeding generator and every decision it drives, the seven graph operator families at unchanged weights, connected-fragment crossover at 0.45 with its finishing edit, the sulfur admission gate, the canonical identity admission path, both duplicate scopes and greedy retention all stay exactly as inherited, and no decision anywhere reads a value from the discarded array. The node therefore prices no component and adds no mechanism; it is one dependent realization of this Anchor's ungated allocator-channel departure distribution.

finding_summary.headline: Placebo ran exactly; ungated allocator-stream luck on this Anchor spans 0.0677 and cost 0.0421, so its +0.0106 is not resolvable
finding_summary.insights:
The premise that motivated this measurement is now inverted, and that is the finding. The campaign suspected that rounds 45 to 47 had been read against a scale roughly four times too wide, because the only channel-matched numbers it owned - a pair drawn on the mask-free Parent - spanned just 0.009482 against the breeding channel's 0.035031. On the Anchor itself the allocator channel is the widest channel measured anywhere on this host: a single ungated re-draw of nothing but stream position costs 0.042098, a second costs 0.109836, and the two-point span is 0.067739. The 0.009482 figure was a property of the mask-free Parent, not of the allocator stream, and it must not be carried onto this host. Arms of rounds 45 to 47 that were called losses at -0.035153, -0.053288, -0.060755 and -0.081702 all sit inside or above the range two pure-luck re-draws sweep here; only -0.126894 and -0.136643 fall below both of them. Which of those arms this band may actually price is a per-arm question of channel and exposure class that belongs to the ledger, not to this node, but the direction of the correction is unambiguous: those readings were too confident, not too conservative.

The Anchor's own +0.010577 over its mask-free Parent does not survive as a resolvable quantity. The ungated allocator-channel half-width on this host is 4.1 times that gain on this arm and 11.2 times on its sibling; the two-point span is 6.4 times it. Even the narrowest departure scale ever measured on this Anchor, the gated breeding reference at 0.023549, is 2.2 times the gain. The only width smaller than +0.010577 anywhere in the campaign is the mask-free Parent's 0.009482, which prices a different host and is inadmissible for an arm standing here. Strictly, the Anchor-versus-Parent difference is itself a cross-host quantity for which no exactly matched reference exists, so this is a bound rather than a matched reading - but the bound runs the wrong way for the restriction: the host that carries the mask is the host where pure path luck is largest.

A second pattern is now hard to ignore. Five independent law-free references have been drawn on this Anchor - two in the breeding stream, one gated and one not, one gated in the allocator stream, and the two ungated allocator points of this round - and all five landed below it, at -0.020452, -0.021233, -0.017924, -0.042098 and -0.109836. These are dependent realizations that share the Anchor's initial records and its code, so this is a direction count and not a width or a significance claim, and it must not be pooled across channel or exposure class. But five of five in one direction is what regression from a selected maximum looks like: the Anchor's 0.607030 is the realization on which it was chosen, and re-running the identical algorithm on a different stream position is expected to come in lower. Any future reading that treats the Anchor's panel as the algorithm's central value, rather than as its best observed draw, inherits that bias.

The departure is also not isotropic jitter, which matters more for planning than the panel mean does. Per objective, across the two independent ungated re-draws, zaleplon_mpo moves by +0.013694 and +0.016916 (span 0.0032) and median_2 by -0.008162 and +0.000824 (span 0.0090): those two objectives are path-stable to about 0.02 and can carry a reading. deco_hop loses 0.089564 and 0.100669 and sitagliptin_mpo loses 0.130178 and 0.163389 in both draws - consistently, not randomly - which says the Anchor's cells on exactly those two objectives are high realizations that re-drawing gives back. drd2_docking is a third regime: +0.003721 here and -0.302864 on the sibling, the whole difference being one cell.

That cell is the sharpest practical lesson in the round. The sibling arm's drd2_docking seed 2 finished at 0.0956 where every other realization of this objective lands between 0.97 and 1.00, including this arm's 0.9714, 0.999992 and 0.9935 - and it did so with its full 300 oracle calls, 290 accepted attempts, no invalid or duplicate proposals, perfect validity and an ok status. Nothing in that run's own receipts flags it; the chemistry report for that arm shows it simply never let go of the inherited sulfonamide fragment and reached the right chemistry only in its last two windows. One such cell moves a seed macro by about 0.18 and a fifteen-cell panel by about 0.06, under unchanged rules, in one channel. So a single-realization arm on this host cannot be read as evidence about a rule at any resolution finer than about a tenth of a seed macro, and quality gates - budget spent, validity, status - cannot detect the failure mode. Readings on this host need either replicate realizations, per-cell screening against the objective's known range, or a statistic that does not let one cell carry a panel.

On median_2 the two apparently conflicting readings are both correct and belong to different levels of description, which this arm can settle from its own receipts. At family level the chemistry is reproduced: both arms converge on a 2-alkylquinoline attached to an N-methyl glycine-anhydride ring and both stall at the same 0.21 to 0.24 ceiling. At graph level nothing is shared: among this arm's top twenty-five molecules there are 14 to 16 distinct Murcko scaffolds per seed, the Anchor has 7 to 16, and the overlap is zero on every seed - exactly what the gated sibling found - while the cells still land within 0.0261. The pair establishes that median_2's top is a scaffold-degenerate plateau: many different ring systems inside one chemotype family reach the same score, so the objective's endpoint is fixed by the family the method can reach and is almost blind to which graph it ends on. As a discriminator of allocation rules at 300 calls median_2 will agree with almost anything, and a narrow median_2 band is evidence about the objective, not about the arm.

On the method itself, this arm independently reproduces two inherited limitations the gated sibling identified, which matters because reproducing them on a completely different path shows they are properties of the method rather than of a lucky run. First, the surrogate ranks worst in exactly the regime where the stall reflex makes it decisive: within-batch agreement between predicted and realized scores is 0.385 over this run's 81 restricted batches against 0.559 over its 354 unrestricted ones (the Anchor: 0.392 against 0.547), and the narrowing is not inert, since 71 of 81 restricted batches buy a different set than a full-mask replay of the same drawn rows would. No value of the trigger or the mask size repairs a ranking that is least trustworthy where it is most used; the class of change that could is a different ranking model - one fitted to order candidates rather than to regress their scores, or one that prices its own disagreement - or a stall response that changes where proposals come from instead of narrowing allocation over the same surrogate. Second, search is scaffold-selection variance dressed as optimization: distinct Murcko scaffolds per hundred proposals fall from 47.1 early to 39.6 late (Anchor 54.1 to 36.1), 26.9 per cent of each session's final hundred proposals sit on the final best molecule's own scaffold, 691 of 870 proposals on one objective still carry the indole of a single initial molecule, and eleven molecules tie at exactly 0.645074 on one deco_hop seed. The chemistry report names the same thing from the molecular side: the generator can decorate a core but cannot hop to a new one, so which family a run ends on is decided early and by chance. That is the mechanism behind the two loss-carrying objectives here - the two tasks whose scaffold family the path chose are precisely the two that moved - and the class of change that addresses it is a proposal operator with skeleton-level moves (ring-system exchange, bioisosteric core swap, fragment-level recombination late in the budget), not a reweighting of the seven existing single-atom edits.

What stays open. This is one dependent realization and the two-point rule rests on exactly two points, so the width is crude and supports no significance statement; the sibling arm that supplies the second point had not been published as a node when this report was written, so Curate should re-confirm the span from its record before the band is used. Whether the stall-conditioned eligibility restriction contributes anything on this host remains unanswered, and this node leaves the catalog's open evidence gap on it exactly as it found it. And the band measured here reads only ungated arms that depart through the allocator stream on this Anchor: an arm confined to restricted batches needs the gated point, an arm that changes the posterior and the stream together still has no matched reference in either channel, and nothing here may be pooled across channel, exposure class or host.
finding_summary.results:
The construction executed exactly as declared, on the real evaluation hardware, and the one prediction the pre-run check could not test on the implementation machine is now closed. A discard receipt was written in every one of the 435 announced batches, 29 per session in all fifteen sessions, each reporting exactly one discarded array of the inherited allocation shape (ten by one hundred sixty, float64, on the selector's own GPU generator), each logged before its own batch's pool and purchase receipts; the Anchor has no such receipt anywhere, and neither run has a single fallback batch. The one-array offset is exact on hardware, not just in arithmetic: for the first fifteen batches of every session the discarded array is bit-for-bit the array the Anchor consumed one step earlier in the same stream, and for the first fourteen the array this run actually spent is bit-for-bit the Anchor's next one. That is 435 array comparisons and 696,000 float64 values with zero mismatches, including the three registered first elements reproduced in all five sessions of each seed. The Anchor published only 29 arrays per session, so batches 16 to 29 of this run consume stream positions the Anchor never reached and cannot be compared; any third draw inside the audited batches would have broken the alignment, and none did.

Every inherited law audits clean on this run's own receipts. One pool, one batch selection, ten purchases and two factorizations on the inherited jitter ladder in 435 of 435 batches; all 4,350 purchases recompute as the sequentially masked argmax of their own logged sample row with the correct per-pick mask update; the stall counter recomputed from this run's own accepted scores agrees with its logged counter in 435 of 435 batches; every restricted batch restricts to exactly the top forty of its own recomputed posterior-mean ordering and no unrestricted batch excludes anything; no purchase anywhere fell outside the eligible set; all fifteen cells spent their full 300 oracle calls on 290 accepted attempts with no invalid and no duplicate proposals, at the registered profile. At identical state the breeding side is byte-identical: in all fifteen sessions the first batch's pool of 160 molecules, its 171 to 193 breeding records, its sulfur-gate decisions, its identity admissions, its posterior means and standard deviations, its score scale and its jitters match the Anchor's, differing only in wall-clock timing fields.

The paths then part immediately and completely. The first differing scored record is evaluation 11 - the first proposal after the shared ten initial records - in all fifteen sessions, and 290 of 300 records differ in every one of them; no session reproduced the Anchor, so this is a real departure realization and not an implementation reading. Exposure drifted with the path: 81 restricted batches of 435 in 30 episodes across 13 of 15 sessions, against the Anchor's 88 in 29 episodes across 13 of 15, with the deepest single episode falling from 17 batches to 9 and the two never-restricting sessions moving from two deco_hop seeds to one deco_hop and one drd2_docking seed.

The panel came in at 0.564932 against the Anchor's 0.607030: paired seed deltas -0.083687, -0.027859 and -0.014748, a fifteen-cell mean of -0.042098, twenty-one times the 0.002 the campaign calls meaningful, with no seed improving. Seven cells rose and eight fell, but the loss is not spread out. Three cells - deco_hop seed 0 at -0.241696 and sitagliptin_mpo seeds 0 and 1 at -0.204634 and -0.163548 - carry -0.609878 of the panel's -0.631469 total, and the remaining twelve average -0.001799, below the minimum effect. Of the four protected task means, zaleplon_mpo (+0.013694) and drd2_docking (+0.003721) hold their 0.02 margins while deco_hop (-0.089564) breaches its 0.03 and sitagliptin_mpo (-0.130178) breaches its 0.02; median_2 sits at -0.008162 with a three-cell band of [-0.025315, +0.008991]. The registered single-panel rule gives this realization a cell spread of 0.084139 and a half-width of 0.043449, band [-0.085547, +0.001351]. Every orientation figure supplied with this ticket - the Anchor's three seed macros, this run's three, the paired deltas and the mean - reproduces exactly from the receipts.

Read beside this round's second ungated allocator-channel realization, the two-array arm at -0.109836, the registered two-point rule gives this Anchor its first ungated allocator-channel width: points at -0.042098 and -0.109836, a span of 0.067739 and a band of [-0.111836, -0.040098], with per-arm cell-dispersion half-widths of 0.043449 and 0.117976. The registered question was whether matching the channel would make the scale materially narrower than the breeding channel's 0.035031. It does not. By every estimator the matched channel is wider - 1.24 times wider on this arm, 3.37 times on its sibling, 1.93 times as a two-point span - and seven times the 0.009482 the identical construction produced on the mask-free Parent.

On the method itself, this arm independently reproduces two inherited limitations the gated sibling identified, which matters because reproducing them on a completely different path shows they are properties of the method rather than of a lucky run. First, the surrogate ranks worst in exactly the regime where the stall reflex makes it decisive: within-batch agreement between predicted and realized scores is 0.385 over this run's 81 restricted batches against 0.559 over its 354 unrestricted ones (the Anchor: 0.392 against 0.547), and the narrowing is not inert, since 71 of 81 restricted batches buy a different set than a full-mask replay of the same drawn rows would. No value of the trigger or the mask size repairs a ranking that is least trustworthy where it is most used; the class of change that could is a different ranking model - one fitted to order candidates rather than to regress their scores, or one that prices its own disagreement - or a stall response that changes where proposals come from instead of narrowing allocation over the same surrogate. Second, search is scaffold-selection variance dressed as optimization: distinct Murcko scaffolds per hundred proposals fall from 47.1 early to 39.6 late (Anchor 54.1 to 36.1), 26.9 per cent of each session's final hundred proposals sit on the final best molecule's own scaffold, 691 of 870 proposals on one objective still carry the indole of a single initial molecule, and eleven molecules tie at exactly 0.645074 on one deco_hop seed. The chemistry report names the same thing from the molecular side: the generator can decorate a core but cannot hop to a new one, so which family a run ends on is decided early and by chance. That is the mechanism behind the two loss-carrying objectives here - the two tasks whose scaffold family the path chose are precisely the two that moved - and the class of change that addresses it is a proposal operator with skeleton-level moves (ring-system exchange, bioisosteric core swap, fragment-level recombination late in the budget), not a reweighting of the seven existing single-atom edits.

What stays open. This is one dependent realization and the two-point rule rests on exactly two points, so the width is crude and supports no significance statement; the sibling arm that supplies the second point had not been published as a node when this report was written, so Curate should re-confirm the span from its record before the band is used. Whether the stall-conditioned eligibility restriction contributes anything on this host remains unanswered, and this node leaves the catalog's open evidence gap on it exactly as it found it. And the band measured here reads only ungated arms that depart through the allocator stream on this Anchor: an arm confined to restricted batches needs the gated point, an arm that changes the posterior and the stream together still has no matched reference in either channel, and nothing here may be pooled across channel, exposure class or host.

molecular.headline: Valid, fused, aromatic, halogen-heavy and flat: every molecule differs from the Parent's, three of five chemotypes do not.
molecular.overall_character: Across 4350 optimizer-proposed molecules (870 per objective, 863-869 of them distinct) this node emits drug-sized, heavily ring-fused, almost entirely aromatic structures decorated by single-atom substitution: digest ring_closure_rate 0.963-0.985 and aromatic_atom_rate 0.961-0.981 on every objective, halogen_rate 0.215-0.991, mean SMILES length 42.9-79.4. The set is completely flat and completely neutral: zero of 4350 molecules carry a stereo marker and zero carry a formal charge (digest stereocentre_rate 0.0 and charged_rate 0.0 on all five objectives), and exactly one of 4350 carries a trifluoromethyl group. The molecule-level answer to the reproducibility question is blunt. Against the Parent n-61b9b3bfb40d, all fifteen task/seed cells diverge at evaluation 11 - the first proposal after the shared ten-molecule initial pool - and 290 of 300 records differ in every cell (289 of 300 for one deco_hop seed). Only 11 to 16 SMILES per cell are shared with the Parent at all, which is essentially the initial pool plus one or two coincidences. So no proposed molecule is reproduced. What is reproduced is the chemotype and the liability profile, and only on three objectives. zaleplon_mpo (both arms converge on N-halogenated indole-2-carboxamides inherited from one initial-pool molecule), drd2_docking (both arms converge on a flexible aliphatic amine bearing two halogen/methoxy aryl arms, both reaching 0.999992 on seed 1 by different molecules) and median_2 (both arms converge on a 2-alkylquinoline plus N-methyl glycine-anhydride chemotype and both stall at 0.21-0.24) are chemically the Parent's output in different clothing. deco_hop and sitagliptin_mpo are not: on those two the scaffold family itself is decided by the random path, and that is where the score moved most (-0.242 and -0.205 on seed 0). The dominant chemical defect is that the generator substitutes heteroatoms as freely as carbon: 1759 of 4350 molecules (40.4%) carry at least one N-F, N-Cl, N-S, O-O, O-F or S-S/S-halogen bond, and that fraction rises at the top of the gradient on four of five objectives.

per_task.generated_character: Small, tight analogue series around one chemotype: a 1H-indole-2-carboxamide (or its aza variant) carrying an N-aryl amide and two or three small ring substituents - methyl, methoxy, vinyl, fluoromethyl, or a fused dihydrofuran. Mean SMILES length 42.9, max 89, mean ~24 heavy atoms with only 0.7% above 35; digest ring_closure_rate 0.978 and aromatic_atom_rate 0.977; 691 of 870 proposals retain the [nH] of the initial-pool indole. The best molecules (0.4556, seed 2) are one scaffold with three halogen permutations. The Parent's own best molecules on this objective are the same indole-2-carboxamide chemotype, so this is the clearest case where a reshuffled random stream changed every molecule and changed no chemistry; the small positive per-seed deltas (+0.026, +0.010, +0.005) are decoration luck on a shared scaffold.
liabilities: N-fluoro and N-chloro anilides dominate the elite: 185 of 870 contain N(F), 36 contain N(Cl); these are electrophilic halogenating agents, not amides
N-sulfanyl amides (93 of 870 contain N(S)), i.e. unsubstituted sulfenamide NH-S, which is not a stable isolable group
a hydrazide-like N(F)-N(Cl) chain in a top-12 molecule, two halogens on adjacent nitrogens
an O-N=C oxime ether written as a free terminal CH imine, chemically a transient species
14 of 870 proposals are five characters or shorter (C, FF, SBr), paid oracle calls that score 0.0
missing_features: no fused five-six bicyclic N-heteroaromatic core of the pyrazolo-pyrimidine type; the series never leaves the indole it inherited
no tertiary acetamide or N-ethyl-N-acyl aniline, only N-halogenated or N-sulfanylated anilides
no nitrile or other small strongly polar aromatic substituent: 2 of 870 molecules contain C#N
no basic or weakly basic aliphatic amine anywhere in the elite series
no stereochemistry and no formal charge at all (digest stereocentre_rate 0.0, charged_rate 0.0)
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The gradient rewards keeping the indole-2-carboxamide intact and then adding one more heavy atom onto the amide nitrogen: 48 of the pooled top 60 molecules are N-fluoro, N-chloro or N-sulfanyl anilides, versus 309 of 870 overall. Ring substitution (ethyl, methoxy, fused dioxolane) tunes the last 0.02. The bottom of the gradient is pure fragment collapse - 19 of 870 proposals have no ring at all and every one of them scores 0.0.

per_task.generated_character: The largest and least controlled molecules in the node, and the one objective where the three seeds built three unrelated scaffolds. Mean 79.4 SMILES characters and 42.4 heavy atoms, 77.7% above 35 heavy atoms, longest string 259 characters / about 120 heavy atoms. Seed 0 built a chlorinated thiopyrano-coumarin linked by aryloxy to a pyridazine, capped by an azo-oxime-ether chain. Seed 1 built a biaryl-fused pyrimidine carrying an in-ring O-O peroxide bridge and an exocyclic methylidene uracil, and its best 20 molecules are one scaffold spanning only 0.644768-0.645074, eleven of them tied at exactly 0.645074. Seed 2 built a repeating aryl-ester oligomer of pyridazine and imide units. The Parent on its own seeds built different families again (and reached 0.856148 on seed 0, against this node's 0.614452), so on this objective neither the scaffold nor the score is path-invariant: this is the single largest per-task divergence in the node, -0.242 on seed 0.
liabilities: in-ring O-O peroxide bridges: 272 of 870 molecules contain an O-O bond and all 20 of seed 1's best molecules do
O-F hypofluorite bonds in 68 of 870 molecules
N-bromo imides (177 of 870 molecules carry a halogen or sulfur on a ring nitrogen) on the seed 2 scaffold, a brominating reagent motif rather than a ligand motif
runaway crossover oligomers: a 259-character, roughly 120 heavy atom fused polycycle still scored 0.5854 and was not penalised
azo plus oxime-ether chains (N=N-O-C=C) on the seed 0 elite, a photolabile and explosive-class motif
18 of 870 proposals are five characters or shorter and none exceeds 0.5009, i.e. the floor
missing_features: no single clean pharmacophore-bearing medium-sized scaffold; the reward is reached by accretion instead
no sulfonamide, no carboxamide to speak of (52 of 870 contain C(=O)N) and no basic amine on the elite scaffolds
no stereocentre on any of the many sp3 ring carbons it builds (digest stereocentre_rate 0.0)
no aryl ether or biaryl linkage held at drug-like mass; the linkers it finds keep growing instead
no trifluoromethyl or other metabolically blocking group anywhere in 870 molecules
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The objective has a high floor - a lone bromine atom and a lone methane both score exactly 0.500 - so the whole search is fighting for about 0.15. Above the floor the gradient rewards sheer size and ring count: all 60 of the pooled best molecules carry a heteroatom-heteroatom bond and 50 of 60 carry an exocyclic (=C) methylidene, and the 0.645074 value is reached by eleven near-identical decorations of one peroxide-bridged pyrimidine. Score is almost flat across those eleven, which means the gradient stopped discriminating.

per_task.generated_character: The most recognisably medicinal set in the node and the one objective whose chemistry is fully path-invariant. The elite molecules are flexible aliphatic amines - a propyl tertiary amine or an N-methyl aminal ring - connecting two substituted benzenes, one typically 3-methoxy or 3-hydroxy and one chlorinated, with 2-3 atom linkers; mean 33.2 heavy atoms, top-60 mean 30.3, digest halogen_rate 0.991. Seed 2 builds a fused bicyclic diamine bearing a 4-chlorobenzyl and a 2-amino-3,5-dichlorophenyl; seed 1 builds the open-chain bis-arylalkyl diamine and reaches 0.999992. The Parent reaches 0.999992 on the same seed with a completely different molecule (a cyclic 1,3-diazinane), delta 1.1e-07. Same pharmacophore, different molecule, same score - the cleanest statement in the node of what is fixed by the rules rather than the path.
liabilities: chloro-aminal N-CH(Cl)-N in the single best molecule, an alkylating chloromethyl-amine equivalent that would not survive isolation
an O-Cl hypochlorite ester on a 0.999990 molecule
strained fused 1,3-diazabicyclic aminals (C1N2CCC2N1) as the amine source, hydrolytically fragile
211 of 870 molecules carry a heteroatom-heteroatom bond, including 13 with O-F and 10 with O-O
clogP-heavy elite: three to four chlorines plus two aryl rings with almost no polar surface left
missing_features: no piperazine, piperidine or other canonical saturated basic heterocycle: the basic centre is an acyclic amine or a strained aminal instead
no explicitly protonated or charged nitrogen (digest charged_rate 0.0) even though the gradient is clearly a basic-amine gradient
no stereochemistry on the benzylic and ring sp3 carbons the elite molecules create (digest stereocentre_rate 0.0)
no aryl sulfonamide or amide retained in the elite; the scaffold abandons every polar linker rather than balancing one
no CF3, OCF3 or other blocked metabolic site on the chlorinated rings
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The gradient is driven almost entirely by one pharmacophore: a protonatable aliphatic nitrogen two to four bonds from an aryl ring, with a second lipophilic halogenated aryl on the other side. The worst molecules are the inherited 3,5-dichlorobenzenesulfonyl prolinamides (0.000212-0.0015), which have an acidic or neutral polar head and no basic centre; 0.019 for the best initial molecule rises to 0.99+ as soon as the sulfonamide and acid are replaced by an alkylamine chain. Potency saturates near 1.0, so the last 120 oracle calls per seed buy nothing measurable.

per_task.generated_character: The most synthetically credible and the least productive set. Molecules are mid-sized (mean 56.2 characters, 31.8 heavy atoms), highly cyclic (digest ring_closure_rate 0.984) and the least halogenated in the node (halogen_rate 0.215). The recurring chemotype is a 2-alkylquinoline (153 of 870 proposals carry the literal quinoline ring closure, inherited from one initial-pool molecule) attached to a saturated N-methyl glycine-anhydride / piperazine-2,6-dione ring, usually with an ethoxy-alkyl benzene on the other side. Seed 0 drifted off the quinoline onto a 2-ethoxyphenyl bicyclic diketopiperazine and found the node's best 0.2331. The Parent's elite on the same objective is the same quinoline-plus-diketopiperazine chemotype at 0.2228-0.2424, so the chemistry is path-invariant here and so is the ceiling; the per-seed deltas (+0.010, -0.009, -0.026) are noise on a plateau neither arm escapes.
liabilities: aminal and hemiaminal ring carbons (N-CH-O and N-CH-N inside the saturated ring) in several top-12 molecules, hydrolytically labile
an N-sulfanyl (NH-S) group on a final-batch molecule, not a stable group
enamine-amide hybrids written as C2=C3...N bridges whose tautomer a chemist would draw differently
76 of 870 molecules still carry a heteroatom-heteroatom bond despite none reaching the elite
13 of 870 proposals are five characters or shorter and none exceeds 0.0125
missing_features: no simultaneous satisfaction of two dissimilar reference structures; the molecules look like a compromise that scores a fifth of the available range
no carboxylic acid, no sulfonamide, no nitrile - the whole polar-group vocabulary is reduced to lactam carbonyls and ethers
no stereochemistry on the several sp3 ring carbons of every elite molecule (digest stereocentre_rate 0.0)
no halogen or trifluoromethyl exploration at all compared with the other objectives (halogen_rate 0.215)
no macrocyclic or spiro alternative to the fused bicyclic diketopiperazine it keeps rebuilding
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The score span is tiny - best 0.2331, median 0.1911 - so the gradient carries almost no information. What separates 0.22 from 0.19 is only whether both halves are present at once: an ortho-ethoxy or ortho-alkyl benzene and the N-methylated diketo ring, joined directly rather than through a long linker. Every pooled top-60 molecule carries a non-aromatic ring closure and none carries a heteroatom-heteroatom bond, which is why this is the only objective whose elite looks makeable. The floor is fragment collapse: 14 of 870 proposals are ringless and the worst are C, C=C and C#C at 0.0.

per_task.generated_character: Small, flat, aggressively monofluorinated bicyclic heteroaromatics. Mean 46.6 characters and 25.5 heavy atoms, the shortest max length in the node (77), digest ring_closure_rate 0.963 and halogen_rate 0.885. The dominant chemotype is a pyrrolo-fused pyrimidine-2,4-dione/2-imino-4-one (a xanthine-like core) carrying an N-methyl, an N-fluoro ring nitrogen, a fluoromethyl on the pyrrole and an N-aryl group that is a 2-hydroxy-difluorophenyl or a hydroxy-benzyl. 571 of 870 proposals contain a CF fluoromethyl, 203 carry a fluorine directly on a ring nitrogen and 242 carry an O-F bond. The Parent's elite is the same fused-dione-plus-fluorine family, so the chemotype is path-invariant - but the score is not: the Parent reached 0.765861 and 0.644370 on seeds 0 and 1 against this node's 0.561226 and 0.480822 (-0.205 and -0.164). Seed 1 in this node never found the fused bicycle at all and stalled on an open 1,3-diazepinone, which is exactly where its 0.48 ceiling comes from.
liabilities: fluorine bonded directly to a ring nitrogen in 203 of 870 molecules and in 24 of the pooled top 60; N-F is a fluorinating reagent motif
O-F hypofluorite bonds in 242 of 870 molecules, including an O-F phenol ether in the seed 1 elite
free amidine-imine tautomers written as an exocyclic (=N) in 171 of 870 molecules; the drawn form is not the stable one
N(F)-CH2F aminal-like fragments, two fluorines on adjacent heteroatom-carbon positions, in the seed 0 elite
28 of 870 proposals are five characters or shorter, the highest fragment-collapse rate in the node, all scoring 0.0
missing_features: no stereocentre at all, on an objective whose elite molecules repeatedly place an OH or NH2 on an sp3 carbon (digest stereocentre_rate 0.0)
no trifluoromethyl and no polyfluorinated aromatic ring: 1 of 4350 molecules in the whole node has a CF3, and the best here carries only two aromatic fluorines
no beta-amino amide: 59 of 870 molecules contain any C(=O)N, and none of the top 12 do
no primary aliphatic amine as a basic head group; the nitrogens are all amide, imide or N-halogenated
no saturated bridged diamine of the triazolopiperazine kind; the core stays aromatic and flat
no amide or ketone carbonyl outside the ring system to carry the fluorinated aryl
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The gradient is a fluorine-count gradient crossed with a fused-bicycle requirement. It climbs by adding F one atom at a time wherever an atom is free - onto carbon as CH2F, onto ring nitrogen as N-F, onto oxygen as O-F - and 33 of the pooled top 60 carry a halogen or sulfur bonded directly to nitrogen. The floor is brutal and the search falls off it repeatedly: the worst molecules are the single atoms F, S and O at 0.0, the median is 0.1937 against a best of 0.5978, and two of the last six proposals of seed 2 are OF and CCBr at exactly 0.0, so the run was still sampling bare fragments in its final batch.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Zero of 4350 optimizer-proposed molecules contain a stereo marker; the digest reports stereocentre_rate 0.0 on all five objectives. Its own highest-scoring molecules nevertheless create genuine tetrahedral centres - CNCC(CC1N2CCC2N1c1cc(Cl)cc(C(C)Cl)c1N)C(N)c1ccc(Cl)cc1 has several - and the generator emits one configuration-free string per topology.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator cannot express stereochemistry at all.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The mutation and crossover operators are stereo-blind: they build sp3 centres and never set or transmit configuration. A task-agnostic fix is an operator that can assign and inherit configuration at an existing sp3 centre, plus canonicalisation that treats two configurations of one topology as two candidates rather than one, so any reward that depends on three-dimensional arrangement becomes reachable at all.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 1759 of 4350 molecules (40.4%) contain at least one N-F, N-Cl, N-S (on amide or ring nitrogen), O-O, O-F or S-S/S-halogen bond. The rate is higher still among the pooled best 60 on three objectives (50/60, 60/60 and 26/60 against whole-set rates of 0.400, 0.674 and 0.243) and holds at 35/60 on a fourth. Concrete cases: the N-fluoro anilide CCc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)N(F)c3ccccc3)cc2c2c1OCC2, the in-ring peroxide bridge of C=COc1ccc2c(c1C)-c1c(NC(c3ccncc3CC)=c3c(=C)n(C=C)c(=O)n(CF)c3=O)nc(C)nc1OO2, the hypofluorite O=Cc1ccc(OF)c(N2CC=CN(F)C(O)N(CF)C(=O)C=C2CF)c1 and the chloro-aminal CCCN(CCC(Cl)c1cccc(OC)c1)C(Cl)N(C)CCc1cc(N)cc(Cl)c1.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator substitutes halogen, sulfur and oxygen onto heteroatoms as freely as onto carbon, and the resulting unmakeable bonds carry the top of the score gradient.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Atom substitution is applied without element context, so the cheapest way to add a heavy atom is onto a nitrogen or oxygen. A task-agnostic generator needs the substitution move restricted by the identity of the attachment atom, or a post-move structural filter that rejects heteroatom-heteroatom single bonds and alpha-halo amines, so the search climbs through makeable analogues instead of reagent motifs.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Exactly 1 of 4350 molecules carries a trifluoromethyl group, while halogen_rate runs 0.80-0.99 on four objectives. On the most fluorine-hungry objective 571 of 870 molecules carry a CH2F, 284 an N-F and 242 an O-F, and the best molecule Cn1c(=O)n(CCF)c(=N)c2c(CF)n(-c3c(O)ccc(F)c3F)cc21 reaches its fluorine count via two fluoromethyls and two aromatic fluorines rather than one CF3.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no fluorinated or otherwise blocked substituent vocabulary; it reaches halogen content one atom at a time.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The operator set is single-atom; it has no notion of a chemically coherent group. A fragment-level mutation vocabulary of common substituents (CF3, CHF2, OCF3, CN, SO2Me, polyfluoroaryl) would let the generator reach the same elemental composition through bonds that exist, and would do so for any reward that is sensitive to composition or to metabolic blocking.

transferable_gaps.evidence: One proposal is a 259-character, roughly 120 heavy atom fused polycycle built from repeated copies of its own scaffold and still scored 0.5854, and the 221-character Cc1ccc(-c2ccc(Oc3cc4c(cn3)-c3c5c(=O)n(Br)c(=O)n(C(C)Oc6ccc(C#N)nn6)c5cn3-c3cc(C(=O)Oc5cc6c(cn5)-c5c7c(=O)n(C(=O)Oc8ccc(-c9cc(C)c(C#N)nn9)nn8)c(=O)n(C(C)Cl)c7cn5-c5cc(C(=O)Oc7ccc(-c8cc(C)c(C#N)nn8)nn7)cnc5O6)cnc3O4)nn2)nn1 was proposed in a final batch. On that objective 77.7% of all 870 proposals exceed 35 heavy atoms, against 0.7% and 0.8% on two others.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no molecular-size ceiling, and crossover re-duplicates the motif it already holds into oligomers.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Nothing in the breeding step bounds mass, so whenever a reward is monotone in size the population inflates until the budget ends. A heavy-atom or molecular-weight ceiling applied at candidate construction, or a size-aware crossover that swaps fragments rather than concatenating parents, would hold the same scaffold exploration at ordinary small-molecule mass.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 82 of 4350 proposals are five SMILES characters or shorter - C, C#C, FF, SBr, OF, CCBr, FS - and every one of them sits at the objective floor; 101 of 4350 contain no ring closure at all. Two of the final six proposals of one session were OF and CCBr, both at 0.0, so fragment collapse is not confined to early exploration.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator deletes down to single heavy atoms and spends oracle calls on fragments that cannot score.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The deletion move has no lower size bound and the allocator cannot tell a one-atom fragment from a candidate before paying for it. A minimum heavy-atom guard at proposal time, or a cheap pre-oracle structural reject, returns roughly 2% of the evaluation budget on every objective without touching any scoring rule.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On two objectives the whole elite is a decorated copy of a single initial-pool molecule: 691 of 870 proposals keep the [nH] indole of COc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)Nc3ccc(F)cc3)cc2c(OC)c1OC, and 153 of 870 on another keep the quinoline of Cc1cc(COc2ccc(NC(=O)C3CN(C)CCC3C(=O)NO)cc2)c2ccccc2n1. Each seed's best 20 molecules are a single-scaffold analogue series, often at an identical score plateau - eleven molecules tied at 0.645074 on one seed, three tied at 0.455556 on another. Against a matched run of the same algorithm on a reshuffled random stream, every proposal after the shared initial pool differs (first divergence at evaluation 11 in all fifteen cells, 290 of 300 records differing), yet on three objectives the resulting chemotype is identical and on two it is a different scaffold family entirely, with the score moving by 0.20-0.24 in those two.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator can decorate a scaffold but cannot hop to a new one; which scaffold a run ends on is decided by its random path, not by a mechanism.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Scaffold identity is reached once, early, by chance and then only decorated, so the variance of the whole method is scaffold-selection variance. A task-agnostic generator needs an explicit core-replacement move - ring-system exchange or bioisosteric core swap that preserves peripheral substituents - and some memory that stops it re-proposing tied decorations of a saturated core, so that reaching a second scaffold is a capability rather than a seed.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 171 of 870 proposals on one objective and 144 of 870 on another carry an exocyclic (=N) amidine-imine written as a free imine, and 106 of 870 on a third carry an exocyclic (=C) methylidene on a ring that is otherwise aromatic, with 50 of that objective's pooled best 60 carrying one. C=C=c1c(=C(Nc2nc(C)nc3c2-c2c(ccc(OC=C)c2C)OO3)c2ccncc2CC)c(=O)n(CF)c(=O)n1C and Cn1c(=N)c2c(CF)n(-c3c(O)ccc(CF)c3F)cc2n(C)c1=O are both written in forms a chemist would redraw.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator explores tautomer and valence variants of one compound as if they were different molecules.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Bond-order mutations are applied without re-perceiving aromaticity or tautomer preference, so the operator produces strings that are distinct to the optimizer and the same compound to a chemist, and the exploration budget is consumed by them. Tautomer and aromaticity canonicalisation before deduplication and before evaluation would both shrink the effective search space and keep the emitted structures in their stable form.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Zero of 4350 molecules carry a formal charge (digest charged_rate 0.0 on all five objectives). On the one objective where the gradient is unambiguous, the worst molecules are neutral sulfonyl prolinamides such as CC(=O)C1CCCN1S(=O)(=O)c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1 at 0.000212 and the best are aliphatic amines such as CCCN(CCc1cc(Cl)cc(C)c1N)CCC(Cl)c1cc(Cl)cc(OC)c1 at 0.999990 - yet the amine is always reached as an acyclic chain or a strained aminal, never as a saturated basic heterocycle, and never as its protonated form.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator never produces an ionizable or formally charged centre, although its clearest score gradient anywhere is a basic-amine gradient.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The operator set has no charge-introducing or ring-forming basic-centre move, so ionisation state is outside the generator's expressive range and basicity can only be approached through neutral acyclic surrogates. Adding saturated N-heterocyclic ring-building fragments and allowing charged species in the candidate representation would make that whole region of chemistry reachable.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.

method_references.title: Austin Tripp and José Miguel Hernández-Lobato. Genetic algorithms are strong baselines for molecule generation. arXiv:2310.09267, 2023. Sections 2–3 and Appendix A describe the anchor.
